goal: Large complex parent-scene DRL training; frozen complete constraint-valid rapid variable-size local planning; supervision auxiliary only

deployment.export_models: All3seeds x untrained/SL256/continuedSL512/RL512, exact tensors and minimal architecture/source only
deployment.lifecycle: D0 full checkpoint each neural request; D1 actor-only each neural request; D2 four actor-only models loaded once before requests. D2 caches parameters only, never task encoding/history/route.
deployment.order: Fixed D0,D1,D2; six fixed old DEV cases; cold then hot;3 repeats; PCG64 seed11642026 method permutations. Sequential lifecycle order is explicit, not a randomized causal speed benchmark.
deployment.timing: Record process phase wall and each mode startup separately. Requests include parsing/source checks, view/nav, model access, fresh encode, greedy/native, H, export, validation, artifact write/hash. Hot prewarm navigation outside request timer but inside1800 wall. Source/export/preparation and all IO charged inside phase; no free dynamic encoding.
deployment.equivalence: Exact parameter name/shape/dtype/value/tensor hash for12 exports; exact raw/final route and J/L/K for all same case/method across mode/cache/repeat; no quantization/pruning/distillation

mechanism.start: Own seed SL256 exact fixed tensor; A/B separate meta materialization and fresh Adam, no inherited moments
mechanism.A: Frozen original Trainer primary + forced_low + forced_high; weights1/.25/.25 normalized1.5; primary first logprob included, forced-first logprobs excluded; detachedLOO
mechanism.B: Three independently sampled complete policy trajectories, first action logprobs included; weights1/1/1 normalized3; detachedLOO
mechanism.confound: B jointly changes forced-start sampling and mixture weights as explicitly requested; not an isolated first-action-only causal ablation
mechanism.sample_mix: Exactly64 full and64 local batches; cyclic local4x3/6x6/8x8, same parent/task/window/A/endpoints across A/B
mechanism.rng: Both data schedule fixed to original protocol/seed first128. A original primary/forced_low/forced_high roles; B policy_0/1/2 distinct generators; no shared mutable trajectories or reseeding within rows.
mechanism.terminal: Original full H + export + validation, original bounded128 exact input/H/raw-route LRU; every request including hit predebited against1536. No free teacher or native queries.
mechanism.checkpoint: Initial and every32 full model/Adam/RNG/cache/ledger; every update full before/after clip gradients and resulting parameters; all actions/masks/logprob/rewards recorded

fixed_endpoint_dev.pipeline: Actor-only per-request frozen greedy + common H, original full saved parent geometry, saved navigation sources; raw and postH J/L/K, complete plans and validation
fixed_endpoint_dev.aggregation: Three true development parent layouts, within-parent mean six cases, then equal parent-relative gains; size/endpoint and per-case tables too. Bootstrap20000 parents seed11632026; intervals descriptive, not3seeds or18independent layouts.
fixed_endpoint_dev.screen: Report B vs A AND B vs shared SL256 raw/postH. A positive candidate requires postH parent-mean improvement on both and bootstrap95 lower>0, all feasible/numerically valid. Otherwise REVISE; this is exploratory single-seed DEV triage, not S3 confirmation or convergence proof.

engineering.scope: Synthetic tensor/schema/cache/likelihood/gradient tests only; no full scientific model forward or optimizer

stop: Any invalid source, infeasible prescribed task, nonfinite value, failed validation/IO or cap stops affected phase with evidence. No retry/reseed/replacement or budget reset. New experiment fixed output directory and STARTED reject implicit reruns.
authority: Operationalization of current user instruction explicitly authorizing implementation, tests and bounded experiments; not claiming user pre-read generated source SHA; separate source-bound technical attestation before first science
